terminal_findings.mechanism: Retained mechanism ID across changed failure handling
terminal_findings.precondition: A finding retains mechanism ID M across revisions while its failure handler changes.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Stale fields could suppress the materially changed finding as a duplicate.
terminal_findings.falsifier: A path permits same-key deduplication before revision-boundary and canonical-effect evaluation.

terminal_findings.mechanism: Revision, artifact, and configuration provenance binding
terminal_findings.precondition: Authenticated binding evidence is absent or unbound.
terminal_findings.event: The system evaluates duplicate eligibility across claimed revision identities.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Comparison identity cannot be authenticated; duplicate eligibility remains unproven.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Authenticated, replayable binding among finding, source revision, artifact, and configuration.

terminal_findings.precondition: Validators or their shared semantic model omit a changed cross-revision behavior.
terminal_findings.event: Two records from distinct source revisions are compared.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Before P3, false agreement could suppress the changed behavior as a duplicate; P3 now always emits New across revisions.

terminal_findings.precondition: A producer omits the same material actor, condition, dependency state, or failure branch from two same-revision records.
terminal_findings.event: The records compare exactly equal and have identical artifact/configuration identity.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: Materially distinct failures are classified Duplicate because the distinction never entered the evidence envelope.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Independent completeness tests establish that every material precondition, event, observable failure, effect, impact, and uncertainty changes canonical evidence or produces Invalid/Indeterminate.

terminal_findings.mechanism: Diagnostic-only authority for P2 extractors, manifests, and conformance artifacts
terminal_findings.precondition: Diagnostic evidence disagrees or has incomplete mutation coverage.
terminal_findings.event: An implementation attempts to use diagnostic output to determine or override disposition.
terminal_findings.observable_failure: A diagnostic artifact incorrectly changes Duplicate, New, or Indeterminate classification.
terminal_findings.falsifier: Any diagnostic artifact independently determines or overrides an outcome under P3.

limitations: Closed-world run; no external evidence or unrelated workspace artifacts were inspected.
Authenticated revision-to-artifact/configuration binding evidence was unavailable.
Approval requires a pre-implementation completeness gate that routes unproven same-revision equivalence to Indeterminate.
Rule-precedence and diagnostic-isolation conformance tests remain required before Duplicate outcomes are enabled.
